items.title: How Axpo replaced ServiceNow with Jira Service Management to transform service delivery
items.summary: How Switzerland’s largest renewable energy producer replaced legacy complexity with sustainable engineering discipline across thousands of employees. The learnings in this blog post are based on Axpo’s session, “Axpo’s three-act journey to modern ITSM”, presented at Atlassian’s Team ’26 Europe conference. You can check out this session and others on demand.
